verdicts.reason: Held Federal Register OCR identifies EO 12943, December 13, 1994, at 59 FR 64553; its entire operative text consists of two amendments to EO 11755.
Held original expressly replaces the second preamble paragraph's section 4082/Attorney General phrase with sections 3621 and 3622/Bureau of Prisons.
Held original adds section 1(c), with the quoted micropurchase exception.
Held EO 11755 contains the quoted preamble language and section 1(a)'s continuing requirement that future covered contracts contain a stipulation.
The cited cutoff-date eCFR API URL and corresponding point-in-time page were inaccessible; a direct retrieval also failed. The evidence-slice excerpt is a lead, not independent confirmation.
The cited Cornell page prints the amended EO 11755, including section 1(c)'s quoted exception. This confirms the page's contents, not its status at the cutoff.
The supplied evidence slice contains the exact status line. Uphold only the explicitly limited claim about what the slice records; the underlying official index was not independently verified.
Both the held EO 11755 and Cornell note contain section 3: 'Executive Order No. 325A is hereby superseded.' Their supersession language concerns that other order.
